Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology (FEIT)
The Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology (FEIT) educates the innovators of the future. We work with industry, government and entrepreneurs to solve real-world challenges. Our graduates and researchers lead the way in engineering and information technology to build a more sustainable future.
